how_to_read: entities: new entities in the strokes format, ready to copy into a part (as S4's merge_fixes accept()). retire: entities to drop in merge_fixes.mjs, with the reason. changes: edits to existing entities; 'set' keys are fields or 'pts.<name>' points, 'add_note' is text to append to the note. checked: the merge notes' list for this range (and the other low entities), read again, with the verdict and the reading. Crops (contrast-stretched scan, some with the east restyle beside it on the same grid) are in /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ran-3d-director/5a5a3bca-3a69-416d-986a-71fd47398c96/scratchpad/S2_second_east_middle/; crop.mjs and ecrop.mjs there make them.
summary: No painted thing in u 25150-27750 was found without an entity, and none of the merged entities is proposed for retirement. The range was walked at zoom 1 (land v 0-1000 and the water v 900-1790), then at zoom 2-2.4 window by window (the far street, the halls and the bank strip, the warehouse, both moored boats' decks, the great willow's crown, the paper shop, the yard, the eating shed and the jetty), and every item on the merge's list at zoom 3.5-6, scan beside restyle. The water holds only current lines and eddies (no boat, float or swimmer); the willow crowns hold no bird; the warehouse doors, the white-walled house, the paper shop's open front, the yard and the eating shed hold nobody beyond the mapped figures. Three notes are proposed (the capped head at 25810, the barrow, the round-topped cart, one optional point move); everything else stays as merged, with the reading in 'checked'.

changes.add_note: Second pass: compared on one crop with the boat's domed basket at (25890-25920, 625-650). That basket is one ribbed half-dome sitting on a flat line at v ~645. This object is two parts: a small, pale, smooth round top (25802-25816, 623-640, no ribs) over a wider body with vertical and slanting ribs (25798-25830, 640-670) that goes down behind the curved mat cabin roof. That reads better as a man seen from behind, bare-headed or in a pale cap, in a ribbed straw cape (蓑衣), than as a second domed basket (the restyle draws exactly that man). Still conf low: a lidded jar standing in a ribbed basket is the other reading.

changes.add_note: Second pass, which reading: the barrow (kept). lessons: A second pass on faint silk gains most by comparing an uncertain shape with a known thing of the same kind on the same crop (S2: the 'head' at 25810 against the boat's own domed basket 90 px east: one is a single ribbed dome, the other a smooth round top over a ribbed body), not by zooming further: above zoom 5 the commons scan shows only weave.

Before writing that an animal stands in a cart's shafts, follow the bed's lines to their end. On S2's far street the round-topped cart's bed stops 30 px short of the horse, with posts between, and its 'front' had been put under the horse's hind feet.
